slides.headline: A landing page is just 5 answers.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.right_sub: Then let AI shape your words.

slides.label: Answer 1
slides.title: Who is it for?
slides.card: Describe my ideal client in 3 lines: their job, their problem, what they tried before.

slides.label: Answer 2
slides.title: What do they get?
slides.card: Turn my service into one promise: what changes for the client, in one sentence, no buzzwords.

slides.label: Answer 3
slides.title: Why believe you?
slides.card: List the proof I can show: results, reviews, years of work. Ask me what is missing. Invent nothing.

slides.label: Answer 4
slides.title: What holds them back?
slides.card: List 5 doubts a buyer has (price, time, trust). Write a short, honest answer to each.
slides.note: Use the doubts you really hear.

slides.label: Answer 5
slides.title: What is the next step?
slides.card: Write 3 button texts with a short line under each. One action only: book, buy or ask.
slides.note: Change one thing at a time.

slides.headline: Which answer is hardest?
slides.sub: Tell us below. Daily AI workflows.

scenes.label: EVERY NEW CHAT
scenes.wrong: New chat. Explain it all again.

scenes.title: Set up one Project
scenes.footer: Set it up once. Reuse daily.

scenes.title: PROJECT INSTRUCTIONS
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: You help me run my [business]. My clients are [who]. Write in a [tone], short sentences. Use the files I added. If something is missing, ask me one question first.

scenes.note: No private client data in Projects.
